additionalDescription: Audio quality is often sacrificed for convenience in modern streaming. Echo was built on the premise that listeners should not have to choose. We developed custom audio codecs and adaptive streaming that deliver studio-quality sound without buffering, even on slower connections.
highlights: Developed lossless audio streaming with adaptive bitrate
Built a social graph connecting listeners with similar tastes
Created a custom audio visualizer using Web Audio API
Implemented gapless playback for seamless album listening
